Wallet universe

SmartMoney is the broad eligibility flag; classification, sources and Interested are independent. L1/L2 mean long-term holders. C1 is a fast clipper/sniper; C2 is a slower clipper/sniper. Existing L1/L2 are SmartMoney; existing F/N/C/S are not. New wallets start Unreviewed until assigned. Import label priority: Interested → Nansen → Fomo → Track V2. Source filters include all memberships, including duplicates.

The original 13 Interested Parties and the nine user-supplied Nansen wallets share this registry. Source labels do not verify trading skill. Interested controls the Snipe / Swing wallet tags. Positive token holdings include dust and unsolicited tokens. Checks run every five minutes; stale means older than ten minutes or a failed check.
